text: 李长荣集团总裁表示，私募股权巨头KKR & Co.计划逐步出售其所持该公司旗下业务的股份，将有利于这家家族控股的中国台湾化工企业加速扩大其半导体材料业务。KKR持有包括李长荣化学工业及一家关联公司的股份。李谋伟在接受采访时拒绝透露KKR份额的可能买家。（彭博）
text_en: The president of LCY Group said that private equity giant KKR & Co.'s plan to gradually sell its stake in the company's business will help this family-controlled Taiwan chemical firm accelerate its expansion into the semiconductor materials sector. KKR holds stakes in LCY Chemical and an affiliated company. Li Mouwei declined to reveal potential buyers for KKR's stake in an interview. (Bloomberg)
